definition_title: Finite divisibility check for new reciprocal-triple endpoints
definition:
import Std
import Init.Grind.Ordered.Module
namespace Erdos302KernelEndpoints734

set_option maxRecDepth 100000
set_option maxHeartbeats 10000000

def endpointCheck (c : Nat) : Bool :=
 (List.range 735).all (fun b => !(0 < b && b < c) || b * c % (b + c) != 0)












end Erdos302KernelEndpoints734
natural_language_statement:
For $c\in\mathbb N$, define a Boolean check over $b\in\{0,\ldots,734\}$ by

$$
\operatorname{check}(c)=\bigwedge_{b=0}^{734}\Bigl(\neg(0<b<c)\ \lor\ bc\bmod(b+c)\ne0\Bigr).
$$

This interface expresses the finite arithmetic obstruction to an integer first denominator when c is the largest endpoint. Downstream kernel certificates evaluate it for 733 and 734; the definition alone is not an assertion that it succeeds.
